moves.name: Fabricate
moves.notes: Always used at the start of combat. This branch is only chosen while fewer than 3 other enemy allies are alive. The move creates 1 defensive bot and 1 offensive bot, and it avoids spawning the same bot twice in a row.

moves.name: Fabricating Strike
moves.notes: Always used at the start of combat. This branch is only chosen while fewer than 3 other enemy allies are alive. The move attacks, then creates 1 offensive bot, and it avoids spawning the same bot twice in a row.

moves.name: Disintegrate
moves.notes: Always used at the start of combat. If 3 other enemy allies are already alive, Fabricator stops fabricating and uses this attack instead.
